description: §14.8.9 S441 round 5 (F2) — the ROW path of a case-variant column. `SELECT … PASSWORDHASH` comes back from the driver keyed by the DECLARED name `passwordHash`; the descriptor records the declared name and the egress redactor compares column names case-insensitively, so the returned row reaches the client as {id, name} with the protected column absent.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix (S441 round-4 review, F2): the descriptor recorded the surface spelling `PASSWORDHASH`, the redactor compared exact-case against the row key `passwordHash`, and the route served the hash. The round-4 case select-upper-column-e006 exercised only the scalar path.
